attribution.title: geoBoundaries gbOpen — Nigeria ADM1 (states) and ADM2 (local government areas)
attribution.underlyingSource: GRID3 Nigeria (boundary year 2022; source data updated 2023-02-26)
attribution.citation: Runfola, D. et al. (2020) geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries. PLoS ONE 15(4): e0231866.
attribution.processing: Parent state assigned by largest geometric overlap; topology-preserving simplification (mapshaper 0.7.98, 10% weighted Visvalingam, keep-shapes); states dissolved from LGAs; equirectangular projection. Geometry is simplified for display and must not be used for surveying or legal boundary determination.
attribution.verification: All 37 units (36 states + FCT) verified against officially published LGA counts; total 774.
